searches.note: Twenty searches of a share of twenty eight, eight left unspent. The VIGNO search (dates, members, rules) is counted under Bouchon and served Garage Wine Co. and Odfjell too; the Villalobos search is counted under Bouchon. Four were restricted to a house's own domain (Bouchon, Garage Wine Co., Odfjell) and two blocked the house's domain so the second source stood apart. No WebFetch was tried.

method: Each record was read with one instruction, refute it: the founding year, the people and their dates, the grapes, the sites, the making, the drinking window, the serving temperature, the label words, the story, the cards and the questions; then the house rules.
Where a claim stood on one secondary source or none it was hedged as the house's or cut; where a source contradicted it, it was set right with the source.
Writers' own sites met among the results (Wine Anorak, Wine with Seth, The Gray Report, Pull That Cork) are cited neither in the fragment nor here.
